items.name: Gemini 4 Neon
items.plain: A faster frontier AI model for coding, analysis and research work that businesses can put straight into everyday workflows.
items.summary: Google's fourth Gemini 4 model, pitched as frontier-level intelligence for complex software engineering, knowledge work and science at faster, lower-cost speeds than its largest models. Rolling out now to AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and through the Gemini API and AI Studio.

items.name: GPT-6.2 Sol
items.plain: An everyday AI model for routine business tasks that lets teams get more work done on the same plan.
items.summary: OpenAI's go-to model for everyday work, updated alongside GPT-6.2 Astra; it handles routine multi-step tasks so users complete more on the same paid plan. Available in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API.

items.name: Microsoft Aion 1.0 Instruct
items.plain: A small open model that will power built-in AI on Windows PCs, so businesses can test on-device AI helpers before they ship.
items.summary: Microsoft published Aion 1.0 Instruct, a 2.3-billion-parameter open-weight model under the MIT license; an optimized version becomes the Windows operating system's built-in small language model by the end of January 2027.

items.name: MAI Image 2.7
items.plain: An image model for creating and editing marketing and product visuals quickly, at a fraction of the cost of rival image models.
items.summary: Microsoft's new image generation and editing model, launched at Ignite, which Microsoft says tops the Artificial Analysis image-editing leaderboard. Available in public preview through Microsoft Foundry, with a cheaper Flash variant for high-volume work.

items.name: Stitch Loop
items.plain: An always-on AI agent that watches a live product, spots problems and drafts fixes for human approval, so small teams keep improving software after launch.
items.summary: A Google Labs experiment: a long-running product agent that connects to a codebase and live metrics, finds what needs fixing and opens GitHub pull requests for human review. A global waitlist is open, with priority for Google AI Ultra subscribers.
